issue_context.title: core.DataFrame(or Series).combine_first  better doc string
issue_context.body:
https://github.com/pandas-dev/pandas/blob/beabf0aab2a1ff7776d1aa30b8ede9d9386f9836/pandas/core/frame.py#L7315

I'm suggesting adding this sentence after the above location to make the function name easier to understand:

The 'first' dataframe overrides the second one where both first.loc[index, col] and second.loc[index, col] are not nan, upon calling
first.combine_first(second).

review_comments: This sounds a lot like altering second inplace. Could you clarify that the result is a new object? Also please use missing values instead of nan
